facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
The Goethe University hotline helps with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Student Secretariat helps with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Central Student Advising office helps with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provides information on residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more for international students. They also offer counseling and support.

The Student Services office supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to ensure that students have the necessary infrastructure for successful studies in areas such as education funding, student housing, cafeterias, and counseling centers.
